About Taqueria Los Reyes

Located at 1150 Federal Rd, Houston, TX 77015, Taqueria Los Reyes is a must-visit destination for anyone craving authentic Mexican flavors in a cozy, welcoming environment. This family-owned diner has become a beloved spot for locals, offering a diverse menu packed with flavorful dishes that are perfect for any occasion.

Taqueria Los Reyes is renowned for its delicious and hearty offerings, with standout dishes that keep customers coming back for more. One of the most popular menu items is the Menudito, a flavorful Mexican soup made with tender tripe and spices, perfect for a satisfying meal. For those in the mood for something savory, the Tacos Tamaulipas are a fan favorite. These tacos are filled with a choice of juicy meats and served with fresh toppings, making every bite a burst of flavor.

Another highly recommended dish is the Fajita Plate Lunch, featuring perfectly grilled fajita meat served alongside warm tortillas, rice, and beans. It’s a filling and delicious option that’s hard to beat. Don’t forget to pair your meal with some Chips & Hot Salsa, the perfect combination of crunchy and spicy for those who love a little heat in their meal. And of course, wash it all down with a cup of great coffee, which has earned praise for its rich flavor and smooth taste.

Taqueria Los Reyes doesn’t just offer amazing food; they also provide exceptional service and amenities that make every visit enjoyable. Whether you're stopping by for a quick bite or enjoying a long meal with family, the diner is designed to accommodate all guests. The restaurant features a wheelchair-accessible toilet, ensuring comfort for everyone. It's a quiet spot, perfect for a peaceful dining experience away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

Families with young children will appreciate the kids’ menu, which offers a variety of dishes that even the pickiest eaters will enjoy. For those who prefer the convenience of modern payment methods, the restaurant accepts credit cards, making it easy for you to settle the bill.

What truly sets Taqueria Los Reyes apart is its commitment to providing an authentic Mexican dining experience in a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere. The combination of quality ingredients, delicious dishes, and excellent customer service has earned it rave reviews from locals and visitors alike.

Whether you’re a regular or a first-time guest, Taqueria Los Reyes is a place where you’ll always feel at home. So, if you're in the area and looking for a great spot to enjoy some Mexican comfort food, make sure to check out this hidden gem. You won’t be disappointed!

For more information or to check out the full menu, stop by the restaurant’s website or head over to 1150 Federal Rd, Houston, TX 77015.

Reviews

“ Their food is so good, and they cook fast, probably less than 10 min, that michelada was amazing, sauce is good charro beans delicious and the trips was real good and crispy 10/10 I order to go but decided to eat there that's why I have that plate... ”

Javier Longoria

“ I was invited to this restaurant quite a while back. My friend had been going there for years. His wife and three kids came with us. I was very impressed with the employees. Very professional and courteous. The food was on point. I will definitely be coming back soon. Everyone in the group was happy with the restaurant! No complaints at all. ”

David Almaguer

“ Authentic Mexican Food, with fresh hand made tortillas and charro beans. I highly recommend to anyone who loves real Mexican food. Service is fast, and atmosphere is down to earth. I come here at least 3-4 times a week. ”

Sergio Herrera

“ i’ve been going to this restaurant since i was little, the food is always great and the service is always very pleasant. the flautas are juicy and crunchy, a must try. ”

andres gonzalez

“ What awesome food. Great service. The restaurant is extremely clean! ”

Bogey Bogott

“ My hubby got the Los Reyes Fajita plate, and I got the authentic enchiladas with beef fajita and chili gravy. Everything was delicious. They even give you a small bowl of beans when they bring you chips and salsa. Definitely coming back to try some different plates. ”

Kimberly Garcia
